verdicts.correction: Secondary positive ref is not legal ISO source: INVOKE L1C15K "NEW" where CLASS-ID L1C15K has no INHERITS clause. New is a method of the BASE class's factory interface (§16.2 / §16.2.1), nothing in §9.3.9, §11.3.4 or §16.2 makes BASE inheritance implicit, so literal-1 names no method of L1C15K's factory interface (§14.9.23.3 SR3). Drop this ref from SR-11.6.3-2 (the negative closes the row alone), or fix the program with REPOSITORY CLASS BASE + CLASS-ID. L1C15K INHERITS FROM BASE. The compiler currently refuses INHERITS FROM BASE with COBOLNET0821 (see misc-p6/p8/p9 refutes), so that fix is blocked until a kb/Work defect note lands.

Expected .out lines are right (VIA ID/SPEAK/WALK/VIA IC/SPEAK/WALK/VIA IB/WALK/VIA IA/SPEAK), but the program relies on the implicit-NEW extension: line 49 INVOKE L1C15K "NEW" on a class with no INHERITS FROM BASE breaks §14.9.23.3 SR3 (New is defined only by BASE, §16.2.1). Fix: add CLASS BASE to L1C15K's REPOSITORY and write CLASS-ID. L1C15K INHERITS FROM BASE. (currently COBOLNET0821, so it is blocked on a compiler defect). Also note: two-base INHERITS (IC INHERITS FROM IA IB) is OPTIONAL feature A.4.10 item 2 (§ Annex, 'Multiple inheritance: INTERFACE-ID paragraph, INHERITS phrase, repetition of interface-name-2'). CONFORMANCE.md claims it, so it is allowed, but the core GR is also pinned by the single-base ID->IC transitive leg.

Not otherwise legal (check d): line 29 INVOKE L1C15RK "NEW" on a class with no INHERITS FROM BASE violates §14.9.23.3 SR3 regardless of the CONSTANT RECORD argument, so SR20 is not the only reason to reject. Fix: CLASS-ID. L1C15RK INHERITS FROM BASE. with REPOSITORY CLASS BASE (blocked, COBOLNET0821). Everything else is sound: the .err COBOLNET1548 matches §13.18.15.3 SR2 via SR20, and 2002 2014 2023 are the right reject-at years (constructs.json constant-record-2002).

Same illegal INVOKE L1C15L "NEW" (no INHERITS FROM BASE; §14.9.23.3 SR3 / §16.2.1). Also, the positive write-back shows the BY REFERENCE general rule rather than SR20's receiving classification. SR20's observable effect is the rejection in the negative, so this ref adds no SR20 coverage.

Not otherwise legal: line 28 INVOKE L1C15SK "NEW" on a class with no INHERITS FROM BASE (§14.9.23.3 SR3; New only via BASE, §16.2.1). Fix with INHERITS FROM BASE + REPOSITORY CLASS BASE (blocked, COBOLNET0821). The .err COBOLNET1548 and reject-at 2002 2014 2023 are otherwise right.
The expected line W=4242 is right, but the program's INVOKE L1C15L "NEW" is illegal without INHERITS FROM BASE (§14.9.23.3 SR3).

The .out is spec-correct (IN FA=0002 FB=0001 FC=0003 / OUT FA=0201 FB=0102 FC=0003 / W=4242) and the rule is pinned by the swapped names, but line 45 INVOKE L1C15L "NEW" is illegal because class L1C15L does not inherit BASE (§14.9.23.3 SR3, §16.2.1). Line 3 is wrong. FUNCTION EXCEPTION-STATUS returns 'A 31-character, left-justified, alphanumeric character string ... all unused characters are alphanumeric spaces' (§15.33.3 1), cite.py OK). DISPLAY therefore writes 'EC=EC-OO-METHOD' followed by 19 trailing spaces (34 characters). The .out has no trailing spaces, and it is not the last line, so the harness's whole-string TrimEnd does not hide the difference. The compiler itself prints the 19 spaces. Correct line 3 = "EC=EC-OO-METHOD                   ". Separately, line 46 INVOKE L1C15N "NEW" is illegal without INHERITS FROM BASE (§14.9.23.3 SR3; §16.2.1), which is the same convention defect as the other OO goldens.
